comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer onto roller slides by clearing rear hooks, close it, and pull-test engagement.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually carry a loaded drawer level above riding height, align two runners, lower onto rails, and slide it.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer is level and engaged on both slides, survives a close-and-release state, then opens to the specified pull-test range without losing its load.
comparison.reason: This is the closest sliding-support neighbor, but it tests lifting hooks over two rollers and seating a large loaded drawer. It does not require a physically butted end-face bridge, uninterrupted raceway support, or retention of independent balls throughout a block transfer.
